cohort: 102 preterm neonates with a gestational age of 28-34 weeks
finding: NIV failure was significantly associated with lower gestational age, male sex, lower birth weight, vaginal delivery, and lower weight gain during hospital stay.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with greater NIV failure rates compared to cesarean section.
birth_weight: Median birth weight in the NIV failure group was 1088 grams
